sections.title: What you can and can't do in Salla
sections.text: We make this clear early, so expectations aren't built on things the platform doesn't allow.

items.label: Customization works within the platform's capabilities and available themes.
Some deep technical changes aren't possible the way they are on open platforms.
The focus is on structure, content and the buying experience.
Integrations are limited to the providers the platform supports.

items.question: How much can a Salla store be customized?
items.answer: Customization is more limited than on open platforms, so we work within Salla's capabilities and focus on structure, content and the buying experience.

items.question: Do you connect local payment and shipping?
items.answer: Yes. We connect the available payment gateways and shipping companies and test the order process from start to finish.

items.question: Can you improve my Salla store's visibility in search?
items.answer: Yes, within what the platform allows: the category structure, category and product descriptions, titles and meta tags.

items.question: Do you upload the products?
items.answer: Product upload and product data organization is a separate service that can be added to your project.

items.question: Can you migrate my store from another platform?
items.answer: Yes. We move your products and categories and put a redirect plan in place for your old URLs.

items.question: How long does a Salla store setup take?
items.answer: It depends on the size of your catalog, the number of pages and the integrations. We set the timeline once the scope is agreed.
